request.name: Find delivery store
request.gqlQuery:
query FindDeliveryStore($input: StoreGetDeliveryStoreDto) {
  findDeliveryStore(input: $input) {
    id
    code
    name
    status
    address
    addressEn
    alertOverloadPercent
    backupStoreIds
    cooldownTime
    countryId
    countyId
    countyName
    distance
    eHoaDonAddress
    eHoaDonCompanyName
    eHoaDonInvoiceSerial
  }
}
